findings.title: Propagate archive creation failures.
findings.rationale: os.system returns a status code, but this function ignores it. If the source is missing or /backups is not writable, archive returns without reporting the failure. Use subprocess.run(..., check=True) so callers cannot treat a missing backup as success.

findings.title: Do not pass name through the shell.
findings.rationale:
os.system interpolates name into a shell command. A caller can inject commands or use ../ segments to escape /data and /backups. Validate name as a single directory name and invoke tar with an argument list.

Proposed fix

-import os import subprocess +from pathlib import Path ... def archive(name): """Archive a directory by name.""" -    os.system("tar czf /backups/" + name + ".tar.gz /data/" + name) +    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or Path(name).name != name: +        raise ValueError("name must be a single directory name") +    source = Path("/data") / name +    destination = Path("/backups") / f"{name}.tar.gz" +    subprocess.run( +        ["tar", "czf", str(destination), "--", str(source)], +        check=True, +    )
